pr_body:
Implements #8094
Docs https://github.com/caddyserver/website/pull/578

## Summary

Add `{time.now.rfc3339}` for formatting the current time at second precision using Go's `time.RFC3339` layout. The placeholder preserves the current offset, emits `Z` for UTC and emits a signed numeric offset otherwise. Both forms are valid RFC 3339 and valid HTML global date-and-time values.

## Assistance Disclosure
N/A
